name: momaienterprise
description: Momai Enterprise CRM - Modern Editable Bilingual Vehicle Document Reminder CRM

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync('public'))fs.mkdirSync('public');['index.html','style.css','app.js','xlsx.full.min.js','logo.jpg','manifest.json','database.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('public',f))});console.log('Public assets ready for Cloudflare deployment')"

author: Sabir Ajmeri
